name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh. So this is where you always meet up with Shiorin."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Then she ain't here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, what? What's with the face? 'Course she ain't here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, she's avoiding you, right? So she can't be here. This is the one place you're sure to show up."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Uh, *now* you figure it out? C'mon, stay sharp. You're cracking me up here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, we're already here, might as well look around, yeah? Y'know, just in case."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm~... I don't see her anywhere. But man, there's more people here than I expected."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I gotta say, I'm not really into these kinda places. Y'know, the ones with lots of kids and families and stuff."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Especially kids... They just start screaming outta nowhere. Can't deal with that."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Did I say something pretty awful just now?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, wait, listen. There's a reason, 'kay? A proper reason."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "My household's kinda complicated, so family doesn't really have a nice ring to it for me. Heck, only bad stuff comes to mind."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So uh, how do I put this... I don't really know what it's like. Y'know, to have a normal, happy family."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whenever I see kids happily playing with their parents, I never see it as sweet or wholesome."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "It kinda ticks me off. All I hear is noise."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, I just made it sound worse. The heck's wrong with me today?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever... I've always been trashy anyway."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, Shiorin ain't here. Let's go."
